name: Langenfeld (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Langenfeld (a hunting horn on white above a red lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Langenfeld; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Langenfeld arms — hunting horn and lion
